title: Little Miss Muffet
text:
Little Miss Muffet sits on a tuffet. She eats her curds and whey every day. She sits in the sun and is very happy.

One day, a big spider comes and sits next to her. Miss Muffet is scared. She runs away from the spider.

questions.text: Where does Little Miss Muffet sit?
What does the spider do in the second paragraph?
Why does Miss Muffet run away from the spider?
options: She wants to play with it
She is tired of the sun

questions.text: How does Miss Muffet probably feel at the start of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a small animal with eight legs

paragraph_translations: A pequena Miss Muffet senta-se em um banquinho baixo. Ela come coalhada e soro de leite todos os dias. Ela senta-se ao sol e está muito feliz.
Um dia, uma aranha grande chega e senta-se ao lado dela. Miss Muffet fica assustada. Ela foge da aranha.
